violations.affected_code: Image(image: asset, width: 64, height: 64, excludeFromSemantics: true,)
violations.explanation: The image is explicitly excluded from the semantics tree. If this image conveys unique or non-redundant information crucial for understanding the category, screen reader users will not be able to access this information. Consider providing a semanticLabel or removing excludeFromSemantics: true if the image is informative and not purely decorative or fully redundant with the 'title' text.
